 await t.test('INTEGRATED PLAN lifecycle and exact helper closure before use',async()=>{for(const suffix of ['precheck','backup',''])await q(await read('../supabase/folha_plano_integrado'+(suffix?'_'+suffix:'')+'.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_plano_integrado_postcheck.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_plano_integrado_rollback.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_plano_integrado.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_plano_integrado_postcheck.sql'));assert.equal((await q("SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','folha_privado.referencia_plano_integrado_v3(text,jsonb,boolean,text,jsonb)','EXECUTE') allowed")).rows[0].allowed,false);});
 const planCall=(actor,body,confirm=false,token=null,conn=a)=>as(conn,actor,'SELECT fn_folha_plano_integrado_v3($1::jsonb,$2::boolean,$3::text) v',[body,confirm,token]);
 const planBody=async(person,sites)=>({version:3,request_id:id(seq++),kind:'primeline',person_id:id(person),date:today,work_id:id(100),expected_daily_revision:(await q('SELECT coalesce((SELECT revision FROM folha_avaliacoes_diarias WHERE colaborador_id=$1 AND data=$2),0) r',[id(person),today])).rows[0].r,sites});
 const site=(work,revision,intervals)=>({type:'obra',work_id:id(work),expected_revision:revision,intervals});
 let planRef=id(889);
 await t.test('INTEGRATED PLAN three destinations/four factual intervals =7h, one atomic operation, one daily expected8h',async()=>{await faltouWorker(777);const sites=[site(100,0,[custom('08:00','10:00'),custom('15:00','17:00')]),site(102,0,[custom('10:30','12:00')]),{type:'reference',id:planRef,reference_type:'garantia',origin_work_id:id(100),original_work_id:id(101),original_reference:'Garantia original do lote integral',expected_revision:0,intervals:[custom('13:00','14:30')]}];const body=await planBody(777,sites),preview=await planCall(10,body);assert.equal((await q('SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_registos WHERE colaborador_id=$1',[id(777)])).rows[0].n,0);const done=await planCall(10,body,true,preview.versao);assert.equal(done.results.length,3);assert.equal(done.daily_summary.minutes,420);assert.equal(done.daily_summary.expected_minutes,480);assert.equal((await q('SELECT sum(minutes)::integer n FROM folha_registos WHERE colaborador_id=$1',[id(777)])).rows[0].n,330);assert.equal((await q('SELECT minutes FROM folha_referencias WHERE id=$1',[planRef])).rows[0].minutes,90);assert.deepEqual(await planCall(10,body,true,preview.versao),done);});
 await t.test('INTEGRATED PLAN moving intervals between works validates final day, no transient overlap failure',async()=>{const rows=(await q('SELECT obra_id,revision FROM folha_registos WHERE colaborador_id=$1',[id(777)])).rows;const rev=work=>rows.find(x=>x.obra_id===id(work)).revision,body=await planBody(777,[site(100,rev(100),[custom('08:00','11:00')]),site(102,rev(102),[custom('11:30','13:00')])]);const p=await planCall(10,body),r=await planCall(10,body,true,p.versao);assert.equal(r.daily_summary.minutes,360);assert.equal((await q('SELECT minutes FROM folha_referencias WHERE id=$1',[planRef])).rows[0].minutes,90);});
 await t.test('INTEGRATED PLAN unauthorized target/stale revision fails before any partial save',async()=>{const rows=(await q('SELECT to_jsonb(f) f FROM folha_registos f WHERE colaborador_id=$1 ORDER BY id',[id(777)])).rows,rev=work=>rows.find(x=>x.f.obra_id===id(work)).f.revision;const body=await planBody(777,[site(100,rev(100),[custom('08:00','10:00')]),site(102,rev(102),[custom('11:30','13:00')])]);await assert.rejects(planCall(13,body),e=>e.code==='42501');await assert.rejects(planCall(10,{...body,sites:[body.sites[0],{...body.sites[1],expected_revision:999}]}),/STALE_REVISION/);assert.deepEqual((await q('SELECT to_jsonb(f) f FROM folha_registos f WHERE colaborador_id=$1 ORDER BY id',[id(777)])).rows,rows);});
 await t.test('INTEGRATED PLAN two connections same request confirm once; modified payload conflicts',async()=>{const rows=(await q('SELECT obra_id,revision FROM folha_registos WHERE colaborador_id=$1',[id(777)])).rows,body=await planBody(777,[site(100,rows.find(x=>x.obra_id===id(100)).revision,[custom('08:00','10:00')]),site(102,rows.find(x=>x.obra_id===id(102)).revision,[custom('11:30','13:00')])]),p=await planCall(10,body);const outcomes=await Promise.all([planCall(10,body,true,p.versao,a),planCall(10,body,true,p.versao,b)]);assert.deepEqual(outcomes[0],outcomes[1]);assert.equal((await q("SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_historico WHERE request_id=$1 AND action='save'",[body.request_id])).rows[0].n,2);await assert.rejects(planCall(10,{...body,note:'different'},true,p.versao),/IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT/);});
 await t.test('INTEGRATED PLAN hidden destination and reference overlap remains blocking; Gerência cannot write',async()=>{const rev=(await q('SELECT revision FROM folha_registos WHERE colaborador_id=$1 AND obra_id=$2',[id(777),id(100)])).rows[0].revision;await assert.rejects(planCall(10,await planBody(777,[site(100,rev,[custom('12:00','14:00')])])),/INTERVAL_CONFLICT/);await assert.rejects(planCall(11,await planBody(777,[site(100,rev,[custom('08:00','10:00')])])),e=>e.code==='42501');});
